note: Proposed by the round-11 maker; not entered in the ledger.

targets.name: Non-ASCII characters a table-measured face maps are measured with that face's advances
acceptance: In Verdana, Arial and Helvetica faces, a character outside U+0020..U+007E that the face's own cmap maps (JDK composite slot 0) is measured with the face's own advance (extracted per face with tools/AsciiAdvanceExtract.swift extended to the own-cmap runs, provenance recorded), not with the SansSerif (Lucida Grande) fallback that chain_text_width uses for ChainGlyph::Mapped.

BT c10a_st_{usec,actu,part,clss}_vd (Verdana italic «Ferrous gauge vista»: Java 157.2197, Rust 153.8428), class-current-spot-cascade/checker custom_class, custom_grouped_class, theme_interface («marker»: Java 61.2366, Rust 58.2214) and BP m9a_vi_hebrew_italic(_ctrl) move to Java's widths, plus held-out Latin-1 / Latin Extended probes; no pass is lost.
targets.evidence: round-11 sweep: these DIFF->DIFF outputs changed only in their ASCII part (now Java's face advances); the remaining gap is the non-ASCII part.

targets.name: StateNodeFont bold is pinned or removed like its italic
acceptance: state.rs StateNodeFont.bold (layout_node_size_with_font, reached in the CLI only with an empty style program) is shown observable and pinned by a Java-backed test, or shown CLI-unobservable as the italic was (a stateFontStyle skinparam always adds a style declaration) and removed; the oracle-tier golden_pairs result names stay identical.
